scholarships.name: International Graduate Network (IGN) Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Non-UK students who graduated from Aberystwyth
scholarships.requirements: Must have successfully completed a full undergraduate degree at Aberystwyth University; must be self-funding; must apply for a full-time Postgraduate Taught program starting in 2026; no separate application form is required.
scholarships.description: A loyalty-based discount for international alumni of Aberystwyth. It offers a 10% reduction on the tuition fees for a full-time Master's degree, recognizing the continued contribution of international graduates to the university community.

scholarships.name: International Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.requirements: High academic achievement in previous studies (equivalent to AAB at A-Level); must be an international fee-payer; submission of a 500-word personal statement justifying academic merit and leadership potential; must hold an offer of study.
scholarships.description: A prestigious merit-based award providing £2,000 per year for up to 3 or 4 years. It is designed to reward the most academically gifted international students across all disciplines at Aberystwyth.
